acceptanceCriteria: Fix the ordering or fixture wait, or bound it with a disclosed limit, without weakening the freed and early-failure assertions.
Reproduce with a recorded run count, or prove the race, for both tests (host, Go version, base).
body: Suspected, not root-caused. On base ce4ae150 (Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64, 2026-10-04), `go test ./internal/tasks/store -run TestPSRSweepSuccessReplaySuccessor` failed 2 of 3 runs with a "not freed" assertion. These were isolated runs, so it is not explained by the concurrent-load sensitivity recorded in V1-0724. The V1-0786 lane separately reported TestPSROrphanEarlyInitializationCleanup failing with "early failure fixture not reached". Related: V1-0724 (PSR tests are load-sensitive) and V1-0779 (live-unknown-gone flake). Expected: deterministic pass in isolation. Actual: intermittent failure. Run counts beyond the 2/3 sample, and the second test's base and frequency, were not retained.
title: tests: TestPSRSweepSuccessReplaySuccessor fails in isolation ("not freed"); TestPSROrphanEarlyInitializationCleanup also reported (suspected)
